caption: The drawing consists of three distinct black-and-white line illustrations of a wooden bench on a beige background. The largest illustration at the bottom displays a front and side perspective of a bench with a scalloped, decorative backrest that features a rounded finial on one side. The bench has a long seat with armrests extending from both ends, and the legs and stretchers are represented with visible wood grain patterns. Above and to the left of the main illustration is a smaller side view of the same bench, showing the curved armrest and straight vertical leg. To the right of this view is a close-up of the curved armrest from above. The entire composition uses fine black ink lines and crosshatching to suggest wood texture and is signed "Edward T. Jewett" in the lower right corner.
title: Mission Bed
